NAYNA TONGE Senior Business Analyst — Product Owner — Scrum Master Domain: Financial Services — Retail Banking — Lending Operations — Workflow Automation

Pune, Maharashtra, India | +91 9561908007 | naynatonge07@gmail.com | linkedin.com/in/nayna-tonge-a09659277

Immediate Joiner | Open to Relocation

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Senior Business Analyst, Product Owner, and Scrum Master with 8+ years of experience delivering digital transformation, workflow automation, and operating model transformation initiatives across Retail Banking, Lending, Investment Operations, and Financial Services. Experienced in partnering with global financial institutions including Northern Trust, BNY Mellon, Citi, SEI, Jackson National, Columbia Threadneedle, Virtus, Alps, Thrivent, Ultimus, Silver Lake, PostFinance, and SWIFT to translate business requirements into scalable technology solutions. Skilled in Business Architecture, Target Operating Model (TOM), Business Capability Mapping, Value Stream Mapping, Process Architecture, Agile delivery, and stakeholder management across enterprise transformation programs.

CORE COMPETENCIES

Business Analysis & Product Ownership: Requirements Elicitation, BRD/FRD, Functional & Non-Functional Requirements, User Stories & Acceptance Criteria, Product Backlog Management, MoSCoW Prioritization, Requirement Traceability, Stakeholder Management

Business Architecture & Operating Model: Target Operating Model (TOM), Operating Model Design, Business Architecture, Business Capability Mapping, Capability Assessment, Value Stream Mapping, Process Architecture, Business Process Design, Operating Model Transformation

Business Process Excellence: Workflow Automation, Business Process Analysis, AS-IS / TO-BE Process Mapping, Gap Analysis, Impact Analysis, Process Optimization, Change Management

Agile Delivery: Agile Scrum, SAFe Agile, Sprint Planning, PI Planning, Backlog Refinement, Release Planning, DoR/ DoD, SDLC

Process Modeling: BPMN, UML, Process Flow Mapping, Wireframing

Technical: JIRA, Confluence, SQL

GenAI for Business Analysis: Prompt Engineering, AI-Assisted Requirement Engineering, RAG, Agentic AI Fundamentals

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Business System Analyst Lead (Senior Business Analyst - Product Owner, FIS Global — Pune, India

Jul 2023 - Present

Project: Enterprise Lending Workflow Transformation Platform

Domain: Financial Services | Retail Banking | Lending Operations | Workflow Automation

Collaborated with business stakeholders from global financial institutions including Northern Trust, BNY Mellon, Citi, SEI, Jackson National, Columbia Threadneedle, Virtus, Alps, Thrivent, Ultimus, Silver Lake, PostFinance, and SWIFT to gather, analyse, and document business requirements.

Delivered business analysis for Investment Operations, workflow automation, and retail lending transformation initiatives across enterprise banking platforms.

Supported Asset Servicing, Custody Operations, Securities Processing, Trade Processing, Trade Settlement, Cash Operations, Corporate Actions, Reconciliation, and Client Onboarding workflows by translating operational requirements into Epics, User Stories, Acceptance Criteria, and business rules.

Performed AS-IS / TO-BE analysis, Business Capability Mapping, Value Stream Mapping, Process Architecture, and Process Design to improve operational efficiency and support enterprise transformation.

Contributed to Target Operating Model (TOM) and Operating Model Transformation initiatives by documenting future-state operating processes, workflow routing, governance, approval hierarchies, and service-level requirements.

• Managed and prioritised a backlog of 200+ user stories while collaborating with Product Owners, Architects,

Engineering, QA, and Operations teams within a SAFe Agile environment.

Defined business rules for trade lifecycle, settlement workflows, exception handling, reconciliation, client onboarding, and workflow automation to improve operational efficiency and regulatory compliance.

Supported UAT, defect triage, release planning, and business sign-off while ensuring successful delivery of workflow automation capabilities.

Leveraged JIRA, Confluence, Microsoft Copilot, and ChatGPT for requirements management, documentation, backlog prioritisation, and productivity improvements.

Deputy Manager (Business Analyst) HDFC Bank — Pune, India

Mar 2018 – Feb 2023

Project: Salesforce Customer 360

Domain: Retail Banking | Lending

Worked as a Business Analyst on the Salesforce Customer 360 transformation initiative, integrating customer data from multiple banking systems to provide a unified 360-degree customer view for business and operations teams.

Supported multiple retail lending products including Home Loans, Personal Loans, Loan Against Property, Credit Cards, Auto Loans, and Business Loans, with exposure to the end-to-end lending lifecycle from onboarding and verification to disbursement and servicing.

Conducted requirements gathering workshops with Business Stakeholders, Product Managers, SMEs, Architects, Operations, Compliance, and Technology teams to define business objectives, pain points, and future-state processes.

Performed AS-IS / TO-BE process analysis, Gap Analysis, and documented BRDs, FRDs, User Stories, Acceptance Criteria, Process Flows, and Business Rules to support Agile delivery.

Gathered and validated requirements related to KYC, Customer Due Diligence, AML controls, document verification, sanctions screening, audit trails, and regulatory compliance, ensuring alignment with business and compliance expectations.

Supported Sprint Planning, Backlog Refinement, UAT, Defect Triage, and Business Sign-off, contributing to improved operational efficiency, reduced manual effort, faster turnaround time, and enhanced decision-making through a single customer view.

Customer Service Associate Amazon India — India

Nov 2014 – Sep 2015

Delivered customer support and handled escalations while maintaining service quality standards.

CERTIFICATIONS & TRAINING

Certificate of Competency in Business Analysis (CBAP) — Trained • Professional Scrum Master (PSM) • Professional Scrum Product Owner (PSPO) • AI for Business Analysts • Lean Six Sigma — White Belt • UiPath RPA Business Analyst (RPA BA) • Project Management Essentials Certified (PMEC) • UX Fundamentals

TOOLS & TECHNOLOGY

JIRA, Confluence, MS Excel, Salesforce Customer 360, ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Microsoft Copilot, Gamma.AI, Visily AI, Napkin

EDUCATION

MBA – Marketing, Indira Institute of Management, Pune University (2016–2018) B.E. – Electrical Engineering, Nagpur University (2010–2014)
